ANSWER: NO

HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document. All specific financial details including:
- Interest rates (5.00% margin for Bankers' Acceptances/Letters of Credit/LIBOR Loans, 3.50% for Prime Rate/USBR Loans)
- Dates (November 30, 2020 waiver date, March 31, 2021 Extended Waiver Period end date)
- Party names (MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc. as Borrower, Bank of Montreal as Administrative Agent, Complex Services Inc. as guarantor)
- Covenant terms (minimum $15,000,000 liquidity, no new advances, weekly reporting, etc.)
- Extension fee (5 basis points on lender commitments)
- Default triggers related to OLG support cessation

are all directly supported by the source document. The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for terms not specified in the waiver document, such as deal size, deal price, and maturity date, which is accurate since this is a waiver document rather than the original credit agreement.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit agreement date (June 10, 2019, amended July 17, 2019)
- Specific financial covenant sections being waived (Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2)
- Closure Default provision reference (Section 11.1.11)
- Compliance certificate delivery requirements (Section 9.1.1.3(a))
- Annual Business Plan delivery requirements (Section 9.1.1.4)
- Complete pricing grid showing all 5 pricing levels with specific leverage ratios and corresponding margins
- Undrawn fee rates (ranging from 0.75% to 1.25% across pricing levels)
- Specific dates of previous waivers (May 15, June 15, June 30, July 31, September 30, 2020)
- Revolving Facility Commitments structure referenced in liquidity calculation
- COSA (casino operating service agreement) threshold and Fixed Component Per Diem payment terms that trigger defaults if relief ceases
